name: Rocco
_note: The flying-game Rocco (owner, 19:20 log 2026-09-26): 'the actual flying Rocco who's on the campaign page, who's the same Rocco flying around on flutiecats.com', as a visitor NPC in Universe B. Not the Universe A Rocco of the memory rooms; a multiverse visitor, docked at the station. `universe` names where an NPC is from; the speaker line shows it.

lines: Rocco, in from the flying game, still catching his breath.
"Up there it's one note and you go up. Down here you just walk?"
"My people are the same, though. Everywhere.
